## Interactive 

```{python}
#| eval: False
#| echo: True
python3 -m mujoco.viewer 
```
and then drag and drop `xml` files from `models/`


## Block Example

```{.python  code-line-numbers="|1,11|2|3,10|4|5|6-9|8|7"}
{{< include _site/models/block.xml >}}
```

```{python} 
import mujoco
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('_site/models/block.xml')
data = mujoco.MjData(model)
data.qpos[0]=0.1

{{< include ../code/renderer.py >}}

```
